description: The central gateway's route ids, published as data so a consumer does not keep its own copy. Owned here, where the routes are defined. 'delegate_rows_may_name' is the published answer to whether a delegate row may name a route: read that field rather than deciding it from the route's name, its module, or a list kept elsewhere.

routes.note: The delegate table is keyed on this route. It is the only route a delegate row may name.
An internal door. It authorizes against its own caller list and never consults the delegate table.
